history.title: Spectrometer_Field_Notes.txt (Baseline Reference)
history.contentPreview: We spent most of Tuesday debugging why the lab spectrometer kept dropping packets whenever the compressor kicked on. Turned out the shielding on the RS-485 run
history.fullText: We spent most of Tuesday debugging why the lab spectrometer kept dropping packets whenever the compressor kicked on. Turned out the shielding on the RS-485 run had split right near the bulkhead clamp, so I spliced in a spare shielded pair from the bench drawer and wrapped the joint in copper tape. Not pretty, but the baseline noise vanished immediately.
history.summary: High sentence-length burstiness, specific physical troubleshooting details, and natural informal ellipsis. No synthetic discourse patterns observed.
